text: Figure 3.1: The Application Interfaces Process The AIT ool enables the manipulation of AI definitions in order to produce the outcome: the .arxml file for data exchange. The AUTOSAR Software Component T emplate [3] tells us what can be modeled. The Standardization T emplate [4] explains and supports the Blueprint approach. The Application Interface definitions apply the rules defined by AUTOSAR Software Component Modeling Guide [5]. All definitions are finally provided in the AUTOSAR_CP_MOD_AISpecification [1] and AUTOSAR_CP_MOD_AISpecificationExamples [2]. In order to standardize Application Interfaces a number of SW Components are described within the AI-T ool decomposed into bigger function groups (formerly called domains) and their main functions. Nevertheless, these components must be seen as examples only . They are necessary in order to specify the ports/port prototypes in a consistent way .
